address: 3555 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109

zones.label: General Admission · Left
zones.description: General Admission on the left gives you the widest-angle view and keeps the ticket cost focused on the show rather than proximity.

zones.label: Pink Circle 2
zones.description: Pink Circle 2 wraps the left side of the central performance area. It is part of the Vegas Sidekick Sweet Spot / Our Pick group.

zones.label: VIP 1
zones.description: VIP 1 sits very close to the stage on the left, prioritizing proximity and performer detail.

zones.label: VIP 2
zones.description: VIP 2 is a close left-center option with a direct angle into the central pole area.

zones.label: Pink Circle 3
zones.description: Pink Circle 3 is centered behind the pole area and gives the most symmetrical view in the room. It is part of the Sweet Spot / Our Pick group.

zones.label: VIP 3
zones.description: VIP 3 is the centered rear VIP row, giving a straight-on look over the central performance area.

zones.label: Pink Circle 4
zones.description: Pink Circle 4 wraps the right side of the central performance area. It is part of the Vegas Sidekick Sweet Spot / Our Pick group.

zones.label: VIP 4
zones.description: VIP 4 is a close right-center option with a direct angle toward the pole and stage.

zones.label: VIP 5
zones.description: VIP 5 is the near-stage right counterpart to VIP 1, emphasizing closeness to the performers.

zones.label: General Admission · Right
zones.description: General Admission on the right gives you the widest-angle view from that side and is the value-focused choice.
